## Workflow Start
**Timestamp**: 2026-07-21T12:11:55Z
**Event**: WORKFLOW_STARTED
**Scope**: feature
**Request**: /aidlc Start a new program intent from docs/intents/W2-04-container-journey-track-trace.md. Work on intent/W2-04-container-journey-track-trace from the common Wave A baseline c2f13dd, based on integ/main-reconciled at c96b5b3. Follow the intent backlog and slicing playbook. Load the complete W2-04 Context Pack first. Deliver the stated vertical slice: journey creation from booking.confirmed, expected moves, DCSA-coded movement capture, lifecycle transitions, containermovement.status publication, Booking consumption, timeline UI, and observable duplicate/out-of-sequence rejection. Do not broaden into EDI ingestion, public DCSA APIs, fleet registry, depot stock, or M&R. Invoke ui-ux-pro-max for every UI page and load design-system/linercore/MASTER.md and design-system/linercore/SESSION-PROMPT.md. Own Container Movement pages only. Do not redesign packages/ui or the shared shell. Record page additions only in design-system/linercore/pages/container-movement.md. Use Graphify and codebase-memory MCP first; use RTK where available. Preserve prior merged intents and keep the W1 waiver explicit, not converted into a real PASS. Protect the manager demo at port 8088. Use scripts/wave-a-compose.mjs and isolated linercore-wave-a acceptance. Run npm run demo:guard before and after. Complete broker-to-database-to-Booking proof, Playwright UI evidence, aidlc-audit, and erp-fidelity-audit. Run all three AI-DLC sessions concurrently, but allow only one session at a time to run the isolated live Compose acceptance stack. W2-02 should merge first; W2-03 and W2-04 must synchronize with integration before their final visual acceptance.
